calibration.text: A bounded native GGML search streams every Qwen decoder block while evaluating an exact serialized byte budget.

scope: one complete relaxed forward/backward through all 40 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B text blocks and all 512 native Q2_0/Q4_0 decisions, including sparse embedding and streamed exact output loss, followed by one exact-byte-manifold Adam update and exact discrete projection; this proves the complete CPU gradient path, not converged optimizer quality or CUDA
